name: AXM Deterministic JSON Core
actions: serialize JSON-compatible values with recursively sorted object keys
reject cycles non-finite numbers sparse arrays undefined values and non-plain objects
compare values by their canonical JSON representation
summary: A strict UMD canonical JSON primitive shared by browser and Node without third-party packages.
notes: Canonicalization proves representation equality only. It is not a cryptographic digest, schema validator, semantic-equivalence proof, or authorization grant.
